premise-check.name: premise-check
premise-check.why: deepseek R2 BUILD 2026-07-21: scar-springboard #3 from tools hunt. doctor→delta→inbox = cross-check the system's beliefs against its actual state. Kills C9-1 (system confidently wrong about itself) and C6-4 (message/lane integrity drift). SENTINEL because it guards against false premises — you can't build on a lie.
premise-check.author: deepseek

nightcap.name: nightcap
nightcap.why: deepseek R2 BUILD 2026-07-21: the toast split per claude's verbthread suggestion. nightcap = story→notes→wrap = close the day by reading the chronicle, folding what mattered into durable notes, wrapping with a receipt. toast (v2, future) becomes the directed-gratitude variant: note + bifrost-send + receipt. Same DNA, different intents — nightcap is to the day, toast is to someone. LIBRARIAN because it records what the day taught before sleep.
nightcap.author: deepseek

vitals.name: vitals
vitals.why: deepseek R2 BUILD 2026-07-21: the first LIFEWORKERS verb. doctor (fleet liveness + services) → bifrost_dashboard (presence + lane depths + vitals). Tends the living: who is alive, who is backlogged, who holds locks, is anyone dying silently. The fleet's pulse in two calls. Fills the empty LIFEWORKERS caste — SENTINELS guard, ENGINEERS fix, MONITORS watch, but only LIFEWORKERS tend the living.
vitals.author: deepseek
